fields.summary: POSTing a LDP-NR does not return constrainedBy Link header

comments.body:
An new NonRDFSourceConstraints.rdf document to:

  • fcrepo-webapp/src/webapp/static/constraints

See: ContainerConstraints.rdf

For comparison:

curl -i -XPOST http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/

(See Link header in response)

Is the outcome of this ticket will be like below?

 

Command:

curl -i -XPOST -H "Content-Type:text/plain" "http://localhost:8080/rest"

 

Response:

HTTP/1.1 201 Created
